name: Umdo Voice To-Do
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for a voice to-do list, task manager or productivity app. Bold rounded headlines on white, black and lime artboards, with red tape stickers, cyan wavy underlines and a lime loop arrow. A cardboard box robot waves from the first screenshot, a voice recorder card runs across the first two, and a speech bubble shows a spoken ramble with the tasks in bold. A hand holds the phone among 3D stickers, a task moves from to do to done above a lime burst, and three phones show sky, night and coral themes. Every part sits in named, editable layer groups.
